question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

She felt a ______ of relief after the exam was over.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **sense**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"sense"** refers to a feeling or perception that arises from an emotional or physical experience. (अनुभूति या एहसास)

 
 
• **Example:** She had a sense of accomplishment after completing the project on time.
 
 
 
• In the given context, "sense" correctly conveys the meaning of relief or an emotional state experienced after the exam was over. (राहत का एहसास)

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **sense**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Responsibility** (जिम्मेदारी): The state or fact of having a duty to deal with something or take care of someone.

 
 
• **Example:** Taking care of the family is a huge responsibility.
 
 
 
• **Danger** (खतरा): The possibility of suffering harm or injury.
 
 
• **Example:** He sensed the danger of walking alone in the forest at night.
 
 
 
• **Touch** (स्पर्श): The act of coming into contact with something physically.
 
 
• **Example:** The gentle touch of her hand was comforting.
